# Psalm 56 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 56:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. Upon Yonath-Elem-Rechokim [Dove-of-Distant-Silences]. Of-David. A-Miktam, when the-Philistines seized-him in-Gath.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. According to The Dove on Far-off Terebinths. A Miktam of David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. To the tune of 'A Dove on Distant Oaks.' A psalm of David, regarding the time the Philistines seized him in Gath.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 56:8 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-[their]-iniquity — escape for-them? In-anger bring-down the-peoples, O-God.
- **LOGOS:** For their crime will they escape? In wrath cast down the peoples, O God!
- **PNEUMA:** Don't let them get away with their wickedness; in Your anger, O God, bring them down.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 56:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** My-wanderings You-have-counted; put my-tears in-Your-bottle. [Are they] not in-Your-book?
- **LOGOS:** You have kept count of my tossings; put my tears in Your bottle. Are they not in Your book?
- **PNEUMA:** You keep track of all my sorrows. You have collected all my tears in Your bottle. You have recorded each one in Your book.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 56:11 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** In-God — I-praise His-word; in-YHWH — I-praise His-word.
- **LOGOS:** In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise,
- **PNEUMA:** I praise God for what He has promised; yes, I praise the LORD for what He has promised.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 56:13 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Upon-me, O-God, [are] Your-vows; I-will-render thank-offerings to-You.
- **LOGOS:** I must perform my vows to You, O God; I will render thank offerings to You.
- **PNEUMA:** I will fulfill my vows to You, O God, and will offer a sacrifice of thanks for Your help.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 56:6 (overlap: 6%)

- **EMET:** All the-day they-twist my-words; against-me all their-thoughts [are] for-evil.
- **LOGOS:** All day long they injure my cause; all their thoughts are against me for evil.
- **PNEUMA:** They are always twisting what I say; they spend their every waking moment plotting to harm me.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
